#overthinker #overthinking #healthybodyhealthymind #wellnessjourney
transcript: One of the quiet struggles of an overthinking mind is this. When attachment forms, your inner world begins to move according to someone else's responses. A message feels warm, you feel calm, a pause feels cold, your chest tightens. Overthinkers are often deeply attuned to emotion. They notice subtle shifts most people miss. A shorter reply, a change in tone, a silence that lingers half a second longer than usual. This isn't weakness, it's often tied to rejection sensitivity. A learned fear of being dismissed, ignored or misunderstood, especially by those who matter most. So the mind replays conversations, not out of drama but out of protection. It scans for signs that love is fading even when it isn't. If you've ever done this without knowing there was a name for it, you're not broken, you're aware. I speak about this gently and honestly in my ebook, The Way Back to Stillness. You can find it through the link in my bio.
